purpose: resident skill baseline for the engineer-lean pack: the same 8 ds-* skills as dsh-engineer-mode, carried here so this package installs alone.
source: copied byte-for-byte from the installed dsh-engineer-mode 0.11.0 assets/skills
precedence: lower wins: project .dsh 100 < project .agents 200 < custom 300 < ~/.dsh/skills 400 < ~/.agents/skills 500 < this package 600
semantics: overlay: a loose copy of the same name always wins; this package keeps the skill resident when the loose copy is missing
driftCheck: scripts/check-drift.mjs compares these hashes with the installed dsh-engineer-mode copy (warn only)

skills.name: ds-blast-radius
skills.description: Find what a change breaks outside its own diff, then prove the key safety fact by running real code. Use before shipping risky or unfamiliar changes. /ds-blast-radius

skills.name: ds-context-reset
skills.description: Keeps a PROGRESS.md for long tasks so a fresh session can resume. Use when a task spans sessions, the model repeats itself, or context is half full, or /ds-context-reset.

skills.name: ds-mode
skills.description: Working style for every coding task: restate, read before editing, one verified step at a time, evidence before claims. Use when starting work or when the run drifts. /ds-mode

skills.name: ds-plan-loop
skills.description: Numbered plan with an acceptance check per step, one critique pass, then execute step by step. Use for multi-file, unclear or previously bungled work. /ds-plan-loop

skills.name: ds-principles
skills.description: Principles with triggers: sizing a diff, choosing types, debugging, testing, delegating. Use at structural decisions, not as a per-turn checklist. /ds-principles

skills.name: ds-tdd
skills.description: Write a focused failing test first, then the smallest change that passes. Use for bugs with a cheap local test target. Not for UI with no test seam. /ds-tdd

skills.name: ds-unstick
skills.description: Name the assumption behind the failed fixes, test it, list three other approaches, restart. Use after the same failure twice. /ds-unstick

skills.name: ds-verify-loop
skills.description: Edit, run the narrowest real check, read the actual error, fix the cause, rerun; stop at 5 rounds. Use when a test, typecheck, build or app can prove the change. /ds-verify-loop
